appearances.title: Elon Musk on Building the Impossible
appearances.description: Elon Musk has spent his career attempting things experts called impossible. In this episode David reads and discusses Walter Isaacson's biography of Elon Musk. Musk says he learned to work through pain as a child in Pretoria, and he argues that the best part is no part. He explains his algorithm for manufacturing: question every requirement, delete parts, simplify, accelerate, and automate. Isaacson describes how Musk's demon mode shaped SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI, and how he recruits engineers by setting impossible deadlines. Chapters (00:00:00) Childhood in South Africa (00:14:20) The algorithm (00:31:05) Demon mode (00:52:40) Lessons from the book. This episode is based on Elon Musk by Walter Isaacson.

appearances.title: Sam Altman on AGI: What He Gets Wrong
appearances.description: Sam Altman says AGI will arrive sooner than most people expect and that society will adapt quickly. In this video I break down his recent blog post and conference remarks, explain where I think he is right about compute scaling, and argue he underestimates deployment friction. He claims costs will fall tenfold every year; I look at the actual pricing data from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Chapters: 00:00 What Altman said 04:10 The compute argument 11:30 Where he is wrong 18:45 My predictions. Sources linked below. Subscribe for daily AI analysis.
